'''''Gastroclonium reflexum''''' is a small [[red alga]] ([[Rhodophyta]]) reported from [[Ireland]] and [[Great Britain|Britain]].

==Description==
This small [[alga]] grows to about 6 cm long: the [[fronds]] grow from a branched [[Holdfast (biology)|holdfast]] are reflexed and form [[Holdfast (biology)|haptera]] where they meet the rock.  The branches are hollow, terete to 6 cm long and constricted by septa giving a beaded appearance. The secondary branching is [[dichotomous branching|dichotomous]], [[distichous]]. In colour they are dark purplish red. <ref name="Irvine 83">{{cite book |author=L. M. Irvine |year=1983 |title=Seaweeds of the British Isles, Volume 1, Part 2A |publisher=[[British Museum (Natural History)]], [[London]] |isbn=0-565-00871-4}}</ref> The species is very similar to ''[[Chylocladia verticillata]]'' with which it may be confused. <ref name="Morton 03">{{cite journal |author=O. Morton |year=2003 |title=The marine algae of County Donegal, Ireland |journal=Bull. Ir. Biogeog. Soc. |volume=27 |pages=3–164}}</ref> Spermatangia, [[cystocarp]]s and polysporangia have been recorded. <ref name="Irvine 83"/>

==Distribution==
''Gastroclonium'' is widely distributed in the north [[Atlantic Ocean]] and [[Mediterranean Sea]], where it grows epilithically or epiphytically in the [[littoral zone|littoral]] or sublittoral zones. <ref name="Irvine 83"/><ref name="Guiry">{{cite web |url=http://www.algaebase.org/speciesdetail.lasso?species_id=445 |title=''Gastroclonium reflexum'' (Chauvin) Kützing |author=M. D. Guiry & Wendy Guiry |date=2004-10-04 |work=[[AlgaeBase]]}}</ref>

In [[Great Britain]], it has been recorded from [[Cornwall]], [[Devon]], [[Sussex]], [[Norfolk]], [[Pembrokeshire]] and [[Glamorgan]]. <ref name="Irvine 83"/> It was first recorded from Ireland by [[W.H.Harvey]] as ''Chylocladia reflexa'' Leorm. and published in 1846. <ref name="Irvine 83"/><ref name="Harvey">{{cite book |author=W. H. Harvey |year=1846 |title=Phycologia britannica... |url=https://archive.org/details/phycologiabri04harv |publisher=Reeve and Benham, London}}</ref><ref name="GCW79">{{cite journal |author=M. D. Guiry, J. P. Cullinane & P. M. Whelan |year=1979 |title=Notes on Irish marine Algae - 3. new records of Rhodophyta from the Wexford coast |journal=Ir. Nat. J. |volume=19 |pages=304–307}}</ref>
Outside the British Isles, ''Gastroclonium'' has been recorded from the [[Channel Islands]], [[Spain]], [[Portugal]], the [[Canary Islands]], the [[Mediterranean Sea]], [[Namibia]], [[Morocco]] and [[South Africa]]. <ref name="Guiry"/>

==Records==
Specimens collected from [[Lough Swilly]] by W. Sawers in 1854 are now preserved in the [[Ulster Museum]] (BEL) (F7058; F7059 and F7060) were redetermined as ''Chylocladia verticillata'' by Guiry as ''Chylocladia verticillata''. <ref name="GCW79"/>
